test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
3 is related to 8 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 24 is related to 35. To which of the following is 99 related following the same logic?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
